title: Controlled-player HP and MP native dispatch

claims.Finding: HP delta with bar0/effects0 reaches a common status clamp and conditional HUD notification for coherent living Sora/Roxas/rescue Mickey. Living bit rejects defeated actors, effects0 excludes recovery animation, positive bounded result excludes the death virtual call.
claims.Limitations: Actor identity, live control, body pins and all selected HUD paths must pass; static branch proof is not live playtesting.

claims.Finding: HP clamps signed delta between status+8 minimum and status+4 maximum and writes status+0. Validate 0<=minimum<=current<=maximum<=255 and requested1..maximum to keep return positive.
claims.Limitations: A scripted minimum can keep HP above requested1; the trainer preserves it.

claims.Finding: Positive healing scans exactly three player pointers atABCFE8 and marks only the matching entry's flagDWORD atbase+24+4*index.
claims.Limitations: Only the actual matching flag requires writable memory; no actor pointer in this table is dereferenced.

claims.Finding: Healing unconditionally reads HUDglobal2A24E90+40; current actor and bar0 matching leads to183220.
claims.Limitations: Missing HUD must reject before HP mutation. Unrelated or absent widget is skipped by native code.

claims.Finding: Damage notification uses the same global/currentactor/bar guard and then1832A0.
claims.Limitations: Same unconditional HUD dependency as healing; no-op HP bypasses native damage notification.

claims.Finding: Positive HUD update writes DWORD4802/4804/4805 and starts animation44 for additional 200HP segments.
claims.Limitations: Widget maximum must match bounded current player maximum; target<=255 bounds this loop to at most one segment.

claims.Finding: Negative HUD update starts animation41 atwidget+2072 and selects44/46 on widget+3584 according to previous/new 200HP segment count.
claims.Limitations: Bound previous widget HP to0..verified maximum; target remains positive. Rendering state must be writable.

claims.Finding: Writes animation ID atmember+468 and forwards inherited EDX to193280(member+32), then clears member+496.
claims.Limitations: The clip argument remains41/44/46; decompiler prototype alone hid this dependency.

claims.Finding: Forwards existing EDX to192050 and writes sequence+320=1,+328=0.
claims.Limitations: No assumed implicit clip0. Member memory guards include all written bytes.

claims.Finding: If sequence+316 or animation table pointer+224 is nonzero, selects36-byte clip row and scans count 144-byte track records from table+216 using ushortfirst/count.
claims.Limitations: Validate exact accessed clip and track spans with overflow checks. Native zero-count and inactive-table branches are preserved. Checks establish mapped access safety, not resource semantic correctness.

claims.Finding: Full MP clears recharge floats444/448 when448>0 before adding maxMP with effects0.
claims.Limitations: Current/maxMP stay0..255; already full with no recharge is a no-op.

claims.Finding: MP-add dispatch follows status actor backlink to3D3CF0 or updates a status without actor.
claims.Limitations: Our coherent field-player guard guarantees a current actor backlink; unbound-status branch is not used.

claims.Finding: With effects0, living actor and nonnegative bounded add, recovery animation and negative-MP depletion branch are unreachable;3C0890 updates status.
claims.Limitations: This is the specifically proven full-restore call shape, not every arbitrary MP delta.

claims.Finding: With recharge cleared/nonpositive and positive bounded add, clamps currentMP to maximum without the recharge-factor resource path.
Nullable packed-pointer decode returns0 for encoded0 and otherwise delegates to4AD3F0.
claims.Limitations: Actual currentactor/status agreement is checked by shared player_role.

claims.Finding: Packed-pointer core uses64 region entries and low25-bit offset after runtime initialization.
claims.Limitations: Checks retain normal game-thread CRT/TLS behavior and do not emulate game runtime initialization.

claims.Finding: CRT-guarded pointer initialization would reset the region table while globalguard is0/-1; health path requires a completed nonzero/nonminusone guard.
claims.Limitations: Trusted native CRT/TLS runtime remains an assumption; no proof for arbitrary external runtime corruption.

claims.Finding: HUD controller construction installs the first controller in global2A24E90 and starts with nullwidget.
claims.Limitations: Supports the global's lifecycle meaning; not called by the trainer.

claims.Finding: HUD controller destruction clears global2A24E90 when the destroyed controller owns it.
claims.Limitations: Missing global during teardown is a real state requiring rejection; not called by the trainer.

limitations: Mapped-span guards and body pins do not establish semantic correctness of every loaded resource.
Player role and controllability classification remains conservative for events/minigames.
Full-restore preflights both paths; there is no general transaction rollback for arbitrary foreign reentrant mutation or a later native failure.
